app.title: Silly Bot Collection
app.disconnected: Disconnected. Your access key was removed from SillyTavern.
app.unsupportedTitle: This SillyTavern version is not supported
app.unsupportedBody: Update SillyTavern to {version} or newer to use Silly Bot Collection.
drawer.notConnected: Not connected. Open the browser to add your access key.
drawer.storageNote: SillyTavern stores extension settings, including the access key, unencrypted on this server. The key can only browse and download.
onboarding.title: Connect to Silly Bot Collection
onboarding.lede: Browse the community's characters and import them into SillyTavern in one click.
onboarding.where: Create an access key in your account settings on the site, then paste it here.
onboarding.badFormat: That does not look like an access key. Keys start with stb_.
onboarding.badBaseUrl: The server address must be an https:// URL.
onboarding.fineprint: The key is stored in SillyTavern's settings without encryption. It can only browse and download, and you can revoke it on the site at any time.
search.idleBody: Type a name, tag or creator.
browse.nsfwLocked: NSFW cards need the NSFW role on Discord.
detail.creator: Creator
detail.truncated: Preview shortened. The full text is in the card.
import.item.lorebook: Lorebook (as World Info, linked to the character)
import.item.lorebookCount: Lorebook with {count} entries (as World Info, linked to the character)
import.item.lorebookUnsupported: This SillyTavern version cannot import lorebooks automatically
import.successWithLorebook: {name} is now in SillyTavern, with the lorebook "{lorebook}".
import.lorebookMissing: The character was imported, but its lorebook could not be imported.
import.error.unsupported: This SillyTavern version cannot import cards from extensions.
import.error.badCard: The download was not a valid character card.
import.error.upload: Could not reach SillyTavern to save the card.
import.error.rejected: SillyTavern rejected the card. It may be damaged.
import.error.missing: The card was saved but SillyTavern did not list it. Reload the page and check your characters.
import.error.lorebook: The lorebook could not be saved.
import.error.openFailed: Could not open the character. Find it in your character list.
duplicate.body: You already imported this character. Update the existing copy, or import a second copy?
duplicate.bodyUpdate: A newer version is available. Update the existing copy, or import a second copy?
empty.feedBody: Like or bookmark a few characters and your feed will fill up.
empty.bookmarksBody: Bookmark characters to find them here.
empty.likedBody: Characters you like show up here.
empty.browseBody: Try another sort or remove the tag filter.
empty.searchBody: Try a shorter or different word.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.invalidKey: This access key is not valid or was revoked. Create a new one in the site settings.
error.notVerified: Your account needs the verified role on Discord to download cards.
error.nsfwRequired: This card needs the NSFW role on Discord.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rateLimitedIn: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection, or the server address in Advanced.
error.badRequest: The server did not understand the request.
error.badResponse: The server sent an unexpected response.
error.server: The server had a problem. Try again later.
